anomalies.description: A large group of individuals, many wearing yellow vests, are engaged in violent unrest in a smoke- and dust-filled urban street at night; objects are being thrown or moved aggressively, and the scene shows chaotic movement consistent with rioting.
A sustained riot scene with police in riot gear advancing through smoke and fire in a narrow street; visible flames, smoke, and coordinated movement of officers indicate collective violent unrest.

A bright, sudden flash of intense red-orange light erupts in the center of the frame (around 54.0s), significantly brighter than ambient firelight and expanding rapidly—consistent with a small explosive device (e.g., Molotov or flare) detonating on the ground.
Large group of protesters wearing yellow vests engaged in violent unrest amid heavy smoke (likely tear gas), with visible movement, dispersal, and confrontation; consistent with riot conditions.
